summary: Still reproduces on main (89e2f98e2): SV_VertexID typed float compiles past Sema and is only rejected at DXIL validation ('SV_VertexID must be uint'), not as a compile-time error. Always-repro'd across all 20 probeable stable releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 (linear scan). PR #3043 added exactly this check and merged 2021-02-25 but was reverted 5 days later ('due to regressions'); both events fall entirely between stable releases v1.5.2010 and v1.6.2104, so no release ever shipped it, and no follow-up has landed since.
title: Declare SV_VertexID as float only get validation error
